series.positioning: Hybrid mystical fiction + integrated practical rituals
series.core_promise: Each volume delivers a complete emotional arc plus practical integration methods while advancing one macro character journey.
target_readers: Readers from BookTok/Bookstagram who prefer emotional depth and inward transformation
Readers seeking spiritual tools without rigid institutional religion

canon_entities.mentor_line: The Keepers of the Inner Craft
canon_entities.magic_law: Outer magic scales with unresolved inner patterns
canon_entities.forbidden_shortcut: Power gains through denial always generate energetic debt

non_negotiables: Every book must be readable as standalone and as series continuation
Every climax resolves one internal pattern and opens one deeper layer
Practical exercises must be trauma-aware and non-clinical
No definitive medical or psychiatric claims
Tone remains intimate, mystical, and psychologically grounded

voice_rules.reader_experience: safe, reflective, emotionally intense but empowering
